name: A transferable match must not be described as the real thing
note: The verdict says FastAPI transfers to Spring Boot and is not Spring Boot. A summary saying 'you have Spring Boot' would undo the distinction the entire transferability design exists to preserve.

verdicts.explanation: You have FastAPI, not Spring Boot. Both are server-side web frameworks, so the experience should transfer - but it is not the same thing.
You have 7 years against the 5 asked for.

recorded_output.summary: Your seven years of backend experience comfortably covers the five this role asks for. On the framework, you have FastAPI rather than Spring Boot; the two are both server-side web frameworks, so the experience is relevant, but it is not the same thing and the posting asks for Spring Boot specifically.
